items.title: Clear skies reveal a sweep of Himalayan peaks from Namo Buddha
items.blurb: Ganesh, Langtang, Jugal, Dorje Lakpa and Gaurishankar are among the ranges visible from the hilltop in Kavrepalanchok.

items.title: China’s Huawei convicted in sprawling US criminal trial over Iran business
items.blurb: A New York jury finds the Chinese telecommunications giant guilty of 10 criminal counts, including bank fraud, sanctions violations and conspiring to steal trade secrets from US companies.

items.title: Three months on, flood-hit communities in Nuwakot remain cut off from district headquarters
items.blurb: The delay in installing a Bailey bridge over the Trishuli river in Bidur has forced thousands to walk for hours to access government services.

items.title: Seven takeaways from Prime Minister Balendra Shah’s India visit
items.blurb: From a two-way air route to an eight-MoU haul, here is what Kathmandu got from Delhi, what it left on the table and what went missing altogether.

items.title: Nepal forecast to receive above-normal precipitation this winter
items.blurb: ICIMOD warns of increased rainfall in the foothills and heavier snowfall at higher elevations, raising the risk of floods, landslides and avalanches in parts of the western Himalaya.
